note: Business-development settings for the Outreach page. 'fit' decides which employers are targets; 'sender' and 'pitch' fill the email drafts. Edit freely; the build regenerates drafts on every run. Bracketed values are placeholders to replace.

pitch.subject: {n_open} open {top_role_lower} role{s} at {facility}: a different way to fill them
pitch.intro: I noticed {facility} is advertising {n_open} open position{s} on Indeed right now{roles_clause}{age_clause}.
pitch.what_we_do: {company} runs recruiting as an outsourced function (RPO) for nursing homes, senior living and home care operators. Our recruiters source, screen and schedule candidates under your name for a flat monthly fee, so the permanent seats stop depending on per-diem agency coverage.
pitch.ask: If it would help to compare that against what the open seats are costing you today, I can walk you through how it would work for {facility} in 15 minutes. Would a call next week suit you?
pitch.footer:
{company} · {address}
If you would rather not hear from us, reply with "unsubscribe" and we will remove you.

urgency_lines.night: Several of them are evening or overnight shifts, which are the hardest to fill through job boards alone.
urgency_lines.weekend: Weekend coverage is in the mix, which rarely fills from a posting by itself.
urgency_lines.bonus: You are already offering a sign-on bonus, which usually means the roles have been open for a while.
urgency_lines.perdiem: Some are per diem or temporary, which suggests agency coverage is already in use.
urgency_lines.old: The oldest posting has been up for {oldest_age} days.
urgency_lines.below_market: The advertised pay for {pay_role_lower} sits below the market median in your area, which makes job-board hiring slow.
